notes.title: Ending Achievements
notes.content:
Todays update primarily adds Achievements to the game.

In addition a few minor errors in the gameplay have been resolved.

Game now includes three Steam Achievements to collect:

 - Best Ending
 - Disappointing Ending
 - Okay Ending
